data_status.description: Static analysis of previously collected data. Values are not live prices.

publication_status.notes: Allowlisted portfolio aggregate; raw source data, private orders, and credentials are excluded.

disclaimers: Historical research snapshot of simulated/analytical results; not live data, not investment advice.
Public aggregate only; raw market data and account-level records are excluded.

definitions.btc_reference_price: BTC reference index level in USD per BTC (reference_price_usd). It is an index observation, not a Kalshi contract price and not an exchange trade price.
definitions.contract_price: Kalshi KXBTC15M YES/NO contract quote in USD per $1 payout (0-1). Not a BTC price.
definitions.contract_volume: Kalshi contract trading volume (volume_contracts). Not BTC spot trading volume.
definitions.implied_probability: Midpoint of YES bid and ask, interpreted as the market-implied probability of YES.
definitions.time_to_close: Seconds from collected_at_utc to the contract close_time (recomputed).

reference_price_series.note: Last reference observation in each right-closed bar (close-only index levels, not OHLC). Empty bars have close null and are never forward-filled. Historical, not live.

implied_probability.unit: probability (0-1) of the YES contract; Kalshi contract price in USD per $1 payout
implied_probability.note: Implied probability = midpoint of yes_bid and yes_ask. Snapshots within a market are strongly correlated; counts are snapshots, not independent observations.

contract_volume.reason: volume_contracts units (cumulative vs per-snapshot, contracts vs dollars) are not verified, so no volume aggregate is published.

btc_spot_volume.reason: No BTC spot trading volume exists in the dataset; contract volume is not a substitute.
